text: Setting clear project goals is essential for success. One effective approach is using SMART goals, which means goals that are Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. Breaking a project into milestones helps the team track progress and stay motivated along the way. Deliverables should also be defined clearly so everyone knows what needs to be produced. Finally, stakeholder alignment is very important. When everyone involved agrees on the goals and understands their role, the project runs more smoothly and the risk of misunderstandings is reduced. Good planning at the start saves time and effort later.
